violations.message: Play declares local process steps but has no adjacent deps.toml; declare every required host tool so pullers get a dependency gate.

Presentation fixture coverage is incomplete: data-bearing steps `history_check`, `tracked_files`, `status_check` have no representative fixture; referenced steps `history_check`, `tracked_files`, `status_check` have no fixture-backed observation. Run the play once and copy the intended observation from `.rote/presentation/<run-id>/input.json` (`steps.<name>.outcome.output.body` for a single output), then place only representative fixture evidence under `resources/presentation-fixtures/` and declare it in `presentation_fixtures:`. Fixtures require a dedicated `<play>/main.ts` package. See `rote guidance play testing` for the evidence and fixture lifecycle.
